game_title: Call Stack Tower – Snow Fort Rush
game_concept: A action puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Snow Fort, a snowball fort: the firewood keeper must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snow Fort: a snowball fort
core_gameplay_loop: In Snow Fort, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round, a new firewood challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 230 points of firewood by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 230, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_height changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Snow Fort.
